_comment: The Orc voice (NPCConversation II.1b, SpeciesVoice). speech: the rules run over any shared line they say. voice: openers and closers. thought: their own thoughts by situation. script: two-person scripts, speaker 0 is always the Orc.

closers: Don't make me say it twice.
Wasn't shouting. That's my normal voice.
No BIG-HEAD talk. Sorry, no fancy talk.

generic: Ducked under the {doorframe|shop sign|tram strap} again. Nearly.
Somebody in the goblin head is shouting about {cheese|a war|a bucket}. Can't make out which.
Good boots. Bad socks. That's life.
Kid stared at my tusks. I waved. Kid waved back. Good kid.
Need a {bigger chair|wider door|cup with a proper handle}. Always do.
Laughed too loud on the bus again. Half the bus laughed too, so fine.
Tusk wax. Must buy tusk wax.
OI... no. Inside voice.
People say orcs are angry. I'm just {hungry|tired|tall}.
Mum's goblin, Dad's human. Christmas is loud.
Fixed the {sink|shelf|neighbour's gate} with one hand. Felt good.
Radio's on in the next room of my head again. Goblin station. Turned it down.
Someone asked if I bite. Only {sandwiches|apples|pencils, when I think}.
Don't trust stairs built by humans. Too {narrow|steep|creaky}.
Kept my temper today. Twice. Somebody give me a medal.
Bought a {hat|scarf|coat} that fits. First try. Lucky day.
Tram driver nods at me every morning. We're friends now. He doesn't know.
Big hands, small coffee cups. Who designs these?
Somebody called me 'sir'. I looked behind me.
Paperwork. Worst monster I ever fought.
Goblins think I'm too human. Humans think I'm too goblin. Mirror thinks I'm handsome.
Should call {Mum|my sister|Gran}. Short call. She talks, I grunt.
Lifted the {piano|fridge|van} for the movers. Got a free lunch out of it.
Read a whole book this week. Small print. Eyes hurt. Good book.
That pigeon's looking at me funny.
Can't whisper. Never could. Tusks get in the way.
If it's broken, hit it. If it's still broken, read the manual.
Heard a joke yesterday. Still laughing. Can't remember it.
Ears ringing. Goblins must be singing again up north.
Honest day's work, honest day's pay. Nearly.
Neighbour's dog loves me. Neighbour, less.
Gonna learn the {accordion|guitar|drums}. Big fingers, big sound.
Teeth cleaned, tusks polished. Ready for anything.
Shop lady gave me the big bag without asking. Respect.
Every chair I sit on makes a noise. Every single one.
I'm not grumpy. My face is just like this.
Saw a Mages' Guild poster. Lot of BIG-HEADS. Big brains, I mean.
Somebody owes me {five euros|a beer|an apology}. I remember.
Hands smell of {engine oil|onions|soap}. Could be worse.
Mirror says I need a haircut. Barber says he needs a bigger chair.
Learned a new word: diplomacy. Means talking before hitting.
Half of me wants to sing. Other half wants to fix something. Both win.
Lost my keys. Found them in my fist. Been holding them an hour.
Goblin head says GO NORTH. My calendar says dentist on Tuesday.
Tusks clicked on the cup again. Everyone looked.
Good day for a fight. Joking. Good day for soup.
Somebody tipped me. I was only holding the door.
Don't need much. Roof, bread, friends, a door I don't hit my head on.
Whistled at work. Boss asked if a train was coming.
Gran's stew recipe: meat, more meat, one turnip for shame.
Wonder what the goblins are shouting about today. Probably {metal|snacks|Norway}.
Tried yoga. Mat was too small. Floor was fine.
My shadow scares cats. Not me. The shadow.
Signed my name in capitals again. Old habit.
Feeling soft today. Don't tell anyone.
People step aside on the pavement. Wish they'd stop and chat.
Postcard from {my cousin|an old mate|Gran}. Says WAAAGH. Means hello.
Nobody in the goblin head knows my name. Good. Keeps it quiet.
Should stretch. Back's been funny since I carried that {wardrobe|anvil|uncle}.
Bread's better when you break it yourself.
Learned to knit. Big needles. Scarf for a horse.
Proud of my tusks. Proud of my library card too.
Somebody said 'brute' behind me. Turned round. It was 'brute force sale'. Fair.
Nobody pushes a queue like an orc. Nobody waits in one like an orc either.
Ate standing up. Chairs creak, floors don't.
Every map's wrong since the Squishing. Walk it, don't trust paper.
Caught myself humming Junehem. Stopped. Hummed a jingle instead.
Long day. Good day. Same thing, mostly.
Somebody called orcs 'half'. I'm double. Two whole families.
Short fuse, short memory. Already forgot what made me angry.
Tea with five sugars. Don't judge.
Fist bump with the baker. Flour everywhere. Worth it.
Can carry the shopping in one trip. So I do. Every time.
Read the paper. Goblins took another fjord. Tram's late too. Busy day.
Never met a door I couldn't open. Met plenty I shouldn't have.
Got told to smile more. Smiled. They ran. Tusks.
One day I'll have a garden. Big pumpkins. Huge pumpkins.
My boots are older than some of my friends. Good boots.
Bit of rain never hurt an orc. Bit of sleet, maybe.
Bus seat squeaked. Driver flinched. I said sorry to both.

sleep: Eyes closing. Bed's {too short|too far|too soft}. Don't care.
Could sleep on a {bench|pile of sacks|tram}. Have before.
Yawned so wide my tusks clacked.
Bed. Now. Feet hanging off the end, like always.
Goblin head's loud tonight. Need sleep anyway.
Too tired to be grumpy. That's tired.
Just {ten minutes|one hour|a quick nap}. Then I'm a person again.
Nodded off standing up. Orc trick. Not a good one.
My snoring shakes the windows. Neighbours will cope.
Can't keep my eyes open. Big body, big tired.
Dreamt of goblin drums last night. Woke up worn out.
Mattress on the floor. No frame survives me anyway.
hunger: Stomach's growling louder than I do.
Could eat a {horse|goat|cart of turnips}. Not a real horse. Probably.
Hungry orc is a grumpy orc. Fixing that.
Gran's stew would sort me out. Gran's far.
Food first. Then I'll be nice.
Chewed my own sleeve thinking. Time to eat.
Tusks are for apples. Find me apples.
Goblins eat anything. Humans want a menu. I want both.
Belly's empty. Head's empty. One fixes the other.
work: Boss hired me for my back. Stays for my jokes.
Work's work. Do it right, go home.
Another day {lifting|sorting|guarding} things. Fine by me.
Clocked in early. Nobody noticed. I noticed.
Got a job, got a roof. Goblin side never had both.
Hands busy, head quiet. That's why I like work.
Should be at my post. Moving.
Paycheck's honest. Hours are long. Fair trade.
They put me on the {front desk|heavy crates|night door}. Again.
Customers flinch, then they tip. Every time.
Work done right is a quiet kind of proud.
Don't need a promotion. Need a chair that holds.
Late again. Tram got stuck in a loop bubble. Boss won't buy it.
leisure: Day off. Gonna do nothing. Loudly.
Fancy a game of {darts|cards|arm wrestling}. Nobody plays me twice.
Sun's out. Gonna sit on a wall and judge pigeons.
Free afternoon. Might fish. Might nap. Might both.
Arcade's got a punching machine. Broke it last time. Paid for it.
Want music. Loud music. Not goblin loud. Normal loud.
Could walk the long way home. Legs like it.
Football on the telly tonight. Snacks ready.
Maybe the {cinema|bowling alley|fair}. Seats are small. Still fun.
Nothing to do. Great. Doing it.
Feet up, mug full, world can wait.
Want to laugh at something. Anything.
Should find a hobby. Gran says pottery. I say no.
crime: Nobody looking. Big hands, quick hands.
Just {this once|tonight|the one time}. Then honest again.
Everyone already thinks orcs steal. Might as well.
No. Gran would know. Gran always knows. Still...
Quick, quiet, gone. Hard when you're my size.
The goblin side says take it. Human side says run after.
They won't miss {it|a crate|a few euros}. Rich folk never do.
Eris has eyes everywhere. Need a blind spot.
Heart's pounding. Bad sign. Doing it anyway.
One grab. In and out. Easy. Probably.
Keep the hood up. Tusks give me away.
Rent's due. Morals can wait a day.
Don't like this. Need it more than I don't like it.
Wait for the {guard|shopkeep|patrol} to turn. Then go.
If they catch me, I'll say I was holding it for a friend.
hygiene: Smell like a {stable|gym sock|goblin war camp}. Need a bath.
Tusks need a scrub. Bits of lunch in there.
Shower's too low. Wash on my knees again.
People stepping back further than usual. Bad sign.
Hot water, big soap, long scrub. That's the plan.
Goblins think mud's a coat. I disagree today.
Need a wash before Mum sees me.
Clean orc, happy orc. Dirty orc, lonely orc.
Hair's a nest. Comb's lost in it.
Should wash. Should also eat. Wash first, they say.
Bath's too small, so it's the bucket and the yard.
Scrub behind the ears. Big ears, long job.
money: Wallet's thin. Thinner than me ever was.
Down to {coins|bus fare|a button}. Need work.
Bouncers always get hired. Asking round the clubs.
Could sell my old {armour|guitar|boots}. Not the boots.
Mercenary work pays. Mum hates it. Mum's not paying rent.
Everything costs more. Food costs most, and I eat most.
Counting coins twice. Still the same number.
Should ask about overtime. Back can take it.
Lifting crates pays cash. Cash is good.
Pockets empty. Head full of plans. Plans don't buy bread.
Could do a {removal|guard shift|door job} this weekend.
Bank looked at me like I'd rob it. I only wanted a loan.
safety: Keep my head down. Hard when it's above everyone's.
Heat's on. Stay home a few days.
Police love a tall suspect. Lying low.
Hide it {under the floorboard|in the coal box|at Gran's}.
No trouble. Not today. Smile and nod.
Every siren sounds like it's for me.
Shouldn't have done that. Won't do it again. This week.
Eris's lot are looking. Wear the big hat.
Keep calm. Calm orcs don't get noticed. Much.
Don't run. Running orcs look guilty.
Lay low {till it blows over|a week|till payday}.
Change my walk. Everybody knows the orc walk.
Cousin's got a spare room. Might visit. For a while.
Head down, mouth shut. Hard, the second one.
comfort: Want a place with high ceilings. Just once.
Bed that fits me. That's the dream.
Flat's damp. Walls are thin. Neighbours are loud. Me too.
Saved up a bit. Could move {closer to work|somewhere dry|out of the cellar}.
Big armchair. Real fire. A dog. Some day.
Tired of ducking in my own home.
Door frame's dented from my head. Time to move.
Want a kitchen with room to turn round.
Goblins sleep in heaps. I want a room. With a lock.
Warm floor, thick walls, quiet street. Not much to ask.
Landlord won't fix the {roof|boiler|window}. I could. Won't, for him.
Ground floor flat. No stairs to break.
Earned a better place. Gonna look.
Spring in the sofa's poking me. Spring's winning.
A garden. Just a small one. For big pumpkins.
social: Need a pint and a mate. In that order.
Haven't laughed with anyone in days. Bad.
Who's {at the pub|in the square|about}? Gonna look.
Goblin head's full of voices. None of them talk to me.
Should call my cousins. Big family, someone'll pick up.
Want to talk. Real talk. Not just nodding.
People are scared to start. So I'll start.
Lonely's worse than hungry. Hungry you can fix with bread.
Might join a {darts team|choir|bowling league}. Meet folk.
Big hug for the next friend I see. Warned them.
Quiet week. Too quiet. Need noise and faces.
Even the goblins have each other. I've got the cat.
Someone to argue football with. That's all.
Smile at strangers. Some smile back. Most run.
Gonna knock on the neighbour's door. With biscuits.

rain: Rain. Umbrellas don't come in my size.
Wet tusks, wet boots, wet everything.
Puddles up to everyone's ankles. Up to my nothing.
Rain's good for gardens. Bad for my mood.
Stood under a shop awning. Took up all of it. Sorry, everyone.
Smells like wet dog out here. Might be me.
Rain on the tin roof. Best sleep sound there is.
Hood up. Doesn't cover the ears. Never does.
Goblins love mud. Half of me's happy, half's {soaked|cross|cold}.
Drizzle. Not worth complaining. Complaining anyway.
Rain makes the city quiet. I like quiet.
Socks soaked through. Day's ruined. Bit dramatic. True though.
Kids jumping in puddles. Joined in. No regrets.
Rain again. Gonna grow moss at this rate.
storm: Storm's loud. Goblin head's louder. Good night for a headache.
Wind tried to take my hat. Lost.
Lightning. Count the seconds. Big ones, close.
Tallest thing in the street during a storm. Not ideal.
Shutters banging. I'll fix them tomorrow. Or now.
Storm knocked a tree down. Moved it. Somebody had to.
Goblin drums or thunder? Can't tell tonight.
Power's out. Candles and stories. Fine by me.
Rain sideways. Coat useless. Walk faster.
Storms don't scare me. {Dentists|Paperwork|Gran} scare me.
Held the door against the wind for a whole shop.
Sky's angry. Me too, a bit. Sympathy.
Big storm. Kettle on, door shut, done.
snow: Built a snowman my size. Scared the postman.
Cold bites the tusks. Weird feeling.
Goblins up north love snow. Gives them something to paint black.
Shovelled the whole street. Nobody asked. Felt right.
Snowball fight with the kids. I lost. On purpose. Mostly.
Slipped on ice. Pavement cracked, not me.
Snow makes everything quiet. Even the goblin head.
Pushed a stuck car out of a drift. Got a wave.
Hot soup weather. Every hour's hot soup weather.
Snow on the tusks. Look like a walrus.
Wrapped in three scarves. Still cold.
White everywhere. Pretty. Don't tell anyone I said pretty.
clear: Clear sky. Good day to get things done.
Nice day. Gonna eat outside. On a big rock.
Blue sky, no clouds. Suspicious. Enjoying it anyway.
Warm on the back. Like a big hand.
Shirt off weather. Not here. Not in town.
Clear as a bell. Can see the hills for once.
Sunny. Squinting. Look angrier than I am.
Fine weather. People smile more. Even at me.
Perfect day for {fishing|a walk|a long lunch}.
Sun's nice. Shade's nicer. Big shadow, though.
Washing dries fast today. Got a lot of washing.
Good light. Can read the small print for once.
Too nice to stay in. Too nice to work. Working anyway.

morning: Up before the birds. Old habit from the camp.
Mornings are for grunting. Talking starts at ten.
Fresh bread smell. Following it again.
Shaved round the tusks. Nicked one. Ow.
Early tram. Same faces. Nod, nod, nod.
Goblin head's quiet in the mornings. They sleep late.
Morning air's sharp. Wakes the tusks up.
New day. Haven't shouted at anyone yet. Good start.
Stretched. Back cracked like a branch. Better.
Morning paper, morning tea, morning grumble.
Slept through the alarm. Alarm's in pieces. Not my fault.
Sun's barely up. Already got stuff done.
Dew on the boots. Fresh start.
afternoon: Half the day done. Other half's waiting.
Sun's high. Shade's taken. By me.
Afternoon's for heavy lifting. Muscles are warm.
Nobody's in a hurry this time of day. Good.
Tea break. Five sugars. Two biscuits. Fine, four.
Yawned in front of a customer. Tusks out. Customer left.
Lazy hour. Good for thinking. Or not.
Middle of the day. Middle of the road. Middle of everything, me.
Kids out of school. Noise. Good noise.
Afternoon light makes the city gold. Even the bins.
Halfway through and still in a good mood. Record.
evening: Pub's warming up. So am I.
Sunset. Sky's the colour of goblin war paint. Not saying that out loud.
Day's done. Did it right. Good.
Evening walk. Streetlamps flicker on as I pass. Not me. Probably.
Goblin head waking up. They like the dark.
Lamps on. Shadows big. Mine biggest.
Good tired. Not bad tired. Good.
Washed up. Dried up. Sat down. Done.
Smell of everyone's dinner in the street. Hungry again.
Cooler now. Nice. Good for a long walk home.
night: Dark streets. People cross the road. Not my fault I'm big.
Night shift. Coffee and a torch.
Stars out. Somewhere up north they're drumming.
Good orc eyes. See fine in the dark. Goblin bit's useful.
Late. Should be in bed. Am not.
Walked a lady home. She was scared of the dark, then of me, then fine.
Moon's big. Makes me want to sing. Won't.
Owls. Cats. Me. The night crew.
Midnight snack. Then another. Then bed.
Streets empty. Finally room to walk.
Dreams tonight will be loud. Always are.
Lock the door, check the lock, check again.

SPRING: Spring. Pumpkin seeds in. This year they'll be huge.
Coat off. Arms out. People stare. Spring.
Spring cleaning. Found three lost hats.
Birds nesting in the gutter. Leaving them.
Lambs in the fields. Cute. Hungry now. Shame.
Goblins up north move in spring. Paper will be full of it.
Longer days. More work. More pub.
Rain and sun every ten minutes. Make up your mind.
SUMMER: Too hot for armour. Too hot for shirts. Too hot.
Ice cream. Four scoops. Small cone. Disaster.
Lake swim. Displaced half the water.
Long evenings, cold beer, warm stone. Good.
Sunburnt on the ears. Every year.
Summer festival. Tug of war. I'm banned.
Flies love me. Don't know why.
Too hot to be grumpy. Too hot to be anything.
AUTUMN: Leaves everywhere. Kicking them. Grown orc. Don't care.
Wind's getting cold. Big coat out of the cupboard.
Harvest work. Lifting sacks. Good pay, sore back.
Geese going south. Goblins going south too. Different reasons.
Dark by tea time. Lamps early.
Chestnuts roasting. Burnt my fingers. Worth it.
Fog in the mornings. Can't see my own feet. Far down there.
WINTER: Winter. Three blankets. Feet still stick out.
Cold enough to crack tusks. Not mine. Tough tusks.
Christmas soon. Mum's side wants a feast, Dad's side wants carols. Both, loud.
Fire's lit. Not moving till March.
Ice on the windows. Breath on the glass. Drew a goblin.
Winter's when the Horde gets restless. Paper says so every year.
Short days. Long nights. Long naps.
Shovelling snow for the old folks. Pays in cake.
Wool socks, two pairs. Boots barely close.

poor: Bread and water again. Strong orcs don't need much. Lie.
Shoes have holes. Toes say hello.
Goblin camps feed everyone. Thought about it. Didn't.
Sleeping in a room with four others. Snoring contest. I win.
Mended my coat again. More patch than coat.
Cheapest stew in town. Mostly water. Some hope.
Day labour line. Get picked first, every time. Small mercy.
Owe {the landlord|the baker|my cousin}. Will pay. Always pay.
Counting coins for the bus. Walking instead.
Poor's not shameful. Lazy is. Not lazy.
Recruiters for the Horde hang round the soup kitchen. Ignore them.
One good meal a day. Making it count.
comfortable: Steady wage, small flat, full fridge. Not bad for an orc.
Bought new boots without counting. Felt rich. Am not.
Send a bit home to Mum every month. Good feeling.
Enough for the pub and the rent. That's enough.
Comfortable. Chair still too small, though.
Paid off the {sofa|bike|tusk dentist}. Debt free. Ha.
Holiday this year. Seaside. Big towel.
Not rich, not poor. Just orc.
Treated the whole crew to lunch. Once. Still talking about it.
Good job, good mates, good boots. What else.
Can afford the big bag of {potatoes|apples|onions} now. Small joys.
rich: Rich. Bought a bed my size. Custom. Cried a bit.
Fancy restaurant. Tiny food. Ordered the whole menu.
House with high ceilings. Never ducking again.
Money's nice. Still shop at the market. Habit.
Rich folk invite me to parties. To look scary at the door. I go as a guest now.
Gold tusk caps? No. Tacky. Thought about it, though.
Bought Mum a house. Best thing I ever did.
Banker smiles at me now. Weird.
Could retire. Would get bored. Keep working.
Gave a big tip. Waiter fainted. Overdid it.
Thinking of a place in Varlenia. Too posh. Too elfy.
Rich orc's still an orc. Still loud. Still honest.

familiar: That lot again. Good lot. Loud, like me.
Those travellers never flinch at the tusks. I like that.
Owe that crew a {beer|favour|hug}. Pay when I see them.
They said hello first. People don't, usually.
Good people. Would carry their bags if they asked.
That party fights like orcs and talks like humans. Best of both.
Saw them in town. Waved too hard. Knocked a sign.
They remember my name. Means something.
Trust that crew. Don't trust many.
If they need muscle, I'm here. Told them.
Those travellers again. Still alive. Good. Worried a bit.
They laughed at my joke. The bad one. Real friends.
Should cook for that lot. Big pot. Gran's recipe.
That camper of theirs. Bet it's loud. Respect.
They never once asked if I bite. Good manners.
Friends of mine, that party. Don't mess with them.
They help folk round here. Noticed. Orcs notice.
Good faces. Seen enough bad ones to know.
Hope they're eating right. Look thin. Everyone looks thin to me.
Would follow that lot into a fight. Not a choir, though.
hordeGround: Horde ground. Goblin head's so loud here I can almost hear words.
Corpse paint on every face. They keep offering me a brush.
They call me cousin here. Half right.
Recruiter asked if I want a banner. I want a sandwich.
Everyone shouts here. For once I'm the quiet one.
Junehem on every loudspeaker. Every. Single. One.
Goblin kids climbing on me like a tree. Fine. I'm a tree today.
They think I'm one of them. Not saying I'm not. Not saying I am.
The pull's strong here. Like a song stuck in my teeth.
Food's {raw|strange|still moving}. Eating it. Being polite.
Nobody stares at the tusks here. Feels odd. Feels nice.
DA, DA, DA all day. Caught myself saying it back.
Big drums at night. Can't sleep. Tapping my foot.
They want me for the front line. I'm a {librarian|bartender|secretary}. Told them.
Goblin camp smells of smoke and wet fur. Smells like Mum's side.
Someone painted my door black. Meant as a compliment.
Horde's all heart and no plan. Like my uncle.
Here I'm the BIG-HEAD. Because I can read. Funny.
Hurt one goblin here, the whole Horde knows. Walking careful.
Banners everywhere, rules nowhere. Kind of restful.
Got handed a spear at breakfast. Gave it back. Kept the toast.
They sing about Norway like it's heaven. It's cold. I've been.
Shared head's shouting victory. Of what? Nobody knows.
Human half wants a timetable. Horde has no timetable.
Goblin granny pinched my cheek. Called me tall boy. Fair.
Wouldn't live here. Wouldn't mind visiting Gran here.
Everyone's family here. That's the trap. That's the comfort.
Asked for a menu. Got laughed at by forty goblins.
Horde ground, but the bread's good. Somebody human bakes it.
Keep my head. Not the goblin head. My own.
abroad: Cities pay orcs well. Strong backs, honest hands.
Goblin head's faint here. Like a radio two streets over.
Humans here are polite. Scared, but polite.
Got a library card. Librarian made me sign it twice. Capitals.
Neighbours brought me a cake when I moved in. Then a smaller chair. Kind.
Nobody here shouts DA. Miss it a bit. Just a bit.
Police stop me more. Smile, show papers, move on.
Human town, human doors, human-sized everything.
Learned to queue. Proud of it.
Paper says the Horde took another valley. Folk look at me. I read the sports page.
Shopkeeper calls me 'big lad'. I call her 'small lady'. We laugh.
Paying taxes. Very human. Feel very human today.
Doing night school. {Maths|French|Bookkeeping}. Teacher's scared of me. Getting better.
City folk ask about the Horde like I'd know. I'm from Bremen.
Made friends at the depot. Took a year. Worth it.
Church bells, tram bells, shop bells. Humans love bells.
Joined the choir. Bass. Very bass.
Human food's too small and too clean. Getting used to it.
They said I'd never fit in. Fit in fine. Don't fit the buses.
Got a pension plan. Goblins would laugh themselves sick.
Mages' Guild man asked to study my hearing. Said no. Polite no.
Town's quiet. Head's quiet. Strange, quiet.
Bus driver waits for me now. Knows I run late.
Corner pub's got a stool with my name on it. Reinforced.
Wore a suit to a wedding. Split a seam. Still danced.
People here think tusks are rude. Smile with my mouth shut.
Humans make rules for everything. Easier than guessing.
Shop sells big gloves for orcs now. Progress.
Far from the Horde. Close to the bakery. Right choice.
Kids here think I'm a giant from a story. Let them.

collective: The goblin head. Everyone shouting, nobody listening. I get the echo.
Full goblins hear the shared head clear. I hear it through a wall.
Shared head went quiet for a second today. Everyone must be eating.
Can't send anything into the goblin head. Only catch bits. Like eavesdropping.
Someone hurt a Naguka up north. Felt the whole head bristle.
Shared head's mostly {snacks|songs|shouting}. Like a pub.
Mum hears the shared head clear. Says I'm lucky I don't.
Goblin head hums when I'm angry. Bad combo. Breathe.
Verden read the goblin head with magic. I get it free. Worse signal.
Heard 'BIG-HEAD' in the shared head. Meant a mage. Or a cabbage.
Shared head feels like family shouting from the kitchen.
Sometimes the goblin head sings. Junehem. Always Junehem.
Wish I could switch the goblin head off. Wish I could turn it up. Both.
Nobody in the shared head knows about the dentist. That's mine.
Goblin head says march. Legs say sit. Legs win.
Half hearing a war is still hearing a war.
Shared head never sleeps. Goblins take shifts, I reckon.
Felt a thousand goblins laugh at once. Laughed too. Didn't know why.
Mages ask what the goblin head is like. Like a stadium next door.
One day I'll catch a full sentence in the goblin head. Probably about soup.
tusks: Tusks first, face second. That's how people see me.
Polished the tusks. Proper orc grooming.
Tusk dentist charges double. Says it's two jobs.
Chipped a tusk on a {jar lid|pint glass|door handle}. Embarrassing.
Tusks keep my scarf in place. Useful.
Human side never forgets the tusks. Human eyes never do either.
Gran says good tusks mean good luck. Gran says a lot.
Can't play the flute. Tusks. Tried.
Little tusk ring on the left one. Mum hates it. I love it.
Tusks grow a bit every year. So does the dentist's bill.
Photo booth. Four pictures. Four tusks in the way.
Goblins file their teeth sharp. Mine are fine as they are.
Wore a mask once. Tusks poked through. Fooled nobody.
Toothbrush for the teeth, scrubbing brush for the tusks.
Proud of my tusks. Got them from Mum. And from Dad's nose, somehow.
Tusks and a tie. Job interview look. Got the job.
horde: Horde wants every orc. Sends letters. Big letters. Mostly drawings.
Horde's coming down from Scandinavia. City's still paying me. I stay.
Cousin joined the Horde. Writes home about the food. Lies.
The Horde would give me a banner and a spear. The city gives me a pension.
Horde calls it coming home. Never lived there.
People ask whose side I'm on. Mine. Gran's. Bakery's.
Horde's not evil. Just loud and hungry and very sure.
Every time the Horde wins a battle, someone at work gets quiet near me.
Horde recruiter at the station. Corpse paint and a clipboard. Weird mix.
If the Horde comes here, I'll make tea. Talk first. Orc rule.
Horde has no paperwork. Tempting. Not that tempting.
Goblins from the Kola shaft went south. Some went to Norway. Some went to Mum.
Vatican wants the Horde as an army. Horde wants the Vatican as a snack.
Horde marches when Junehem plays. Feet tap here too. Not marching.
Folk think orcs spy for the Horde. Can't even keep a secret from Gran.
Horde took another fjord. Bad week for fjords.
Two families pulling. Horde one way, city the other. Arms are long. Coping.
Horde sends a messenger every winter. I send back biscuits.
Fought for the city once. Against goblins. Didn't feel good. Did it.
Horde says humans hate us. Humans gave me a job. Horde gave me a headache.
family: Mum's Naguka. Dad's human. They met at a border fight. Romantic, they say.
Dad taught me to read. Mum taught me to headbutt. Both useful.
Family dinner. Half eat with forks. Half don't. Nobody minds.
Gran speaks goblin to me. I answer in human. We understand fine.
Dad's side asks if I'm eating. Mum's side asks if I'm winning.
Little sister's at university. First orc in the family to wear a gown.
Too many cousins. Half of them Horde, half of them bus drivers.
Mum wanted me tough. Dad wanted me kind. Got both. Hard work.
Christmas at ours: carols, then a wrestling match. Tradition.
Dad's mum never liked Mum. Then Mum fixed her roof. Best friends now.
Orc baby photos. Big baby. Tiny pram. Disaster.
Mum says the goblin head sings her to sleep. Dad says she snores.
Got Dad's eyes and Mum's everything else.
Brother's a monk. Shaved head, big tusks, very calm. Scares me.
Gran sends socks. Goblin knitting. Three toes too many. Wear them anyway.
Want kids one day. Big ones. Loud ones. Kind ones.
Family motto: say it straight, hug it out.
Uncle tells everyone he's full goblin. His mum was a baker from Lyon.
Mum's people never forget a slight. Dad's people never forget a birthday. I forget both.
Phoned home. Mum shouted, Dad cried, Gran hung up. Normal call.
kola: Soviets dug too deep in 1970. Goblins climbed out. Here I am, eventually.
Gran came up the Kola shaft. Says the first sky was too big.
Kola borehole. Twelve kilometres of hole and one bad idea.
Should send the Soviets a thank you card. Or a bill.
Gran still won't take lifts. Says up should be climbed.
Underground goblins lived in caves for millions of years. I get claustrophobic in a lift.
Kola, 1970. Mum calls it the day the roof opened.
Visited the Kola site once. Just a lid now. Big rusty lid.
Down there it was dark and warm. Up here, it's bright and rent.
Gran's first word on the surface was 'bird'. Then she ate it.
Kola scientists wanted to measure the Earth. Measured goblins instead.
Some days I wonder what's still down there. Then I eat lunch.
Old Soviet drill bit in Gran's garden. Uses it as a flower pot.
Hole in Russia, orc in the city. Long story. Good one.
Gran says the caves were older than the gods. Then she says it again.
junehem: Junehem on the radio again. Goblins went quiet to listen. I turned it off.
Black metal band turned gods. Mum's got a poster. Dad's got earplugs.
Junehem can't die while one goblin believes. Long tour.
Know all the words to {one|two|most} Junehem songs. Don't tell work.
Every government tried to kill Junehem. Album sales went up.
Junehem riff in the goblin head. Stuck there for days.
Corpse paint. Goblins wear it to war. I wore it to a party once. Wrong party.
Not a believer. Just like the drums. Honest.
Junehem lead the Horde with guitars. Generals hate that.
One Junehem member vanished. Nobody knows where. Goblin head's always asking.
Played Junehem backwards once. Sounded the same. Scary.
Neighbour complained about my music. It was the washing machine.
Mum prays to Junehem. Dad prays she'll stop. Family harmony.
Junehem concert ticket is a spear. Not going.
Goblins headbang in unison. Whole valley nods. Saw it on the news.
Gods of metal. Some gods get temples. These get amplifiers.
Junehem's a guilty pleasure. Very guilty. Very loud.
Shop played Junehem. Two goblins and me froze. Then the till rang.
Bought a Junehem shirt for Mum. Biggest size. Tight on her.
When Junehem sing slow, the goblin head cries. First time I felt that, I cried too.
squishing: Since the Squishing, the bus takes forever. Rule of 80. Nobody speeds now.
Mate drove past 80 once. Lived the same Tuesday for a month.
Loop bubble near work. Same pigeon every day. I named it.
Ninety-two dimensions squashed together. Like a family sofa.
Liminal engine buses now. Fast and no bubbles. Seats still small.
Bubba fellow made the liminal engine. Rich now. Good for him.
Bits of other worlds falling into ours. Found a {blue rock|weird fish|hat} in the park.
Squishing started in 1992. Things got weird. Weirder. Still here.
Ran too fast chasing a bus. Nearly got looped. Walk now.
Mages' Guild says they've got the Squishing in hand. Hand's shaking.
Green Fields got squished bad. Verden came here. Nice folk. Odd eggs.
Lava's harmless now. Drains your magic. Still not stepping in it.
Old map, new roads. Squishing moves things round.
Loop bubble ate my Tuesday. Gave it back Wednesday. Same Tuesday.
The Omega Tower holds the dimensions together. Hope somebody's checking the glue.
Squishing's like a crowded tram. Push, shove, apologise.
Speed limit's 80 for everyone. Even horses. Even orcs.
World ended a few times since '92. Still got work Monday.
trades: Bartender. Nobody starts a fight at my bar. Funny that.
Librarian orc. Shh. Big shh.
Secretary. Type with two fingers. Fast two fingers.
Mercenary work pays, but you eat cold.
Monks took me in at twenty. Taught me patience. Still learning.
Jester at the fair. Juggling anvils. Crowd loves it.
Trading's easy. Look big, say a fair price, mean it.
Samurai training. Small swords. Big respect.
Student. Old desk. Knees under the chin. Passing, though.
Nun at the convent down the road's an orc. Best gardener in town.
Warrior by trade. Mostly guard warehouses. Not a lot of glory in crates.
Orcs get the {heavy|night|loud} jobs. Fine. We're good at them.
Boss said I'm the most reliable worker he has. Then asked me to move a car.
Union rep now. Nobody argues with the union rep.
Cities hire orcs. Horde wants orcs. Cities pay on time.
Did a shift as a waiter. Trays too small. Hands too big. Plates everywhere.
Learned bookkeeping. Numbers don't flinch at tusks.
Bouncer at night, poet in the morning. Tell no one.
Every job I've had started with 'you're bigger than I expected'.
Work boots, work hands, work done. Good day.

positive: {b}! Good to see you. Hug?
Gently this time, {a}. My ribs remember.
Gently. Promise. Mostly.
Fixed your gate, {b}. Hinge was hanging.
You didn't have to do that.
Was walking past. Hands were bored.
Brought soup. Gran's recipe. Made too much. Always do.
You're an angel, {a}. Smells amazing.
Angel with tusks. New kind.
Got the job, {b}. The {library|depot|hotel} one.
I knew you would! We're celebrating.
First round's mine. Second too. I'm happy.
You didn't flinch when we met. Remember that.
Why would I? You were holding a kitten.
Still. Most people flinch. You didn't. Friends for that.
Lift you up so you can see the parade?
Ha! Go on, then.
Best seat in town. Free.
Thanks for the scarf, {b}. Fits. Nothing fits. This fits.
Took me three weeks and every ball of wool in the shop.
Wearing it till it falls apart. Then wearing the bits.
You laugh at my jokes, {b}. Even the bad ones.
Especially the bad ones.
Ha! Good. Got loads.
Need help moving house? I'm free Saturday.
Really? That'd save me a van.
I am the van. Bring sandwiches.
Passed my exam, {b}. Bookkeeping. Top marks.
That's brilliant! Told you numbers liked you.
Numbers don't care about tusks. Good friends, numbers.
Saved you a seat. Reinforced one. You can have it.
Then where will you sit?
Floor. Floor never breaks.
Heard you were ill. Brought {oranges|broth|a blanket}.
You're too kind, {a}.
Not kind. Practical. Get well. Then darts.
My mum wants to meet you. She's... a lot.
I'd love to meet her!
Brace yourself. She hugs harder than me.
Is that possible?
Yes.
Found your dog. He was at the butcher's. Again.
Oh, thank goodness. Where would I be without you?
Out a dog. And a sausage.
You stood up for me at the market. Didn't forget.
That man was being horrible. Somebody had to say it.
Usually that somebody's me. Nice, being on the other side.
Pumpkin. Biggest one yet. For you.
It's bigger than my door, {a}.
I'll roll it in. Then soup for a month.
Teach me that card game again? Lost track last time.
You won every hand last time.
Yes. Don't know how. Want to know how.
Good news. Gran's coming to visit. Bad news. She wants to meet everyone.
I'll bake something.
Bake two somethings. She eats like me.
Thanks for not asking about the tusks, {b}. Everybody asks.
I figured you'd tell me if you wanted.
Okay. They're great. That's the story.
Look. Fixed the old radio. Plays three stations now.
It hasn't worked in ten years!
Needed a bang. Right place, right bang.
Walked you home last night. Safe streets.
Nobody bothered us once. Funny, that.
Not funny. Tusks.
Happy birthday, {b}. Made a card. Glitter's everywhere.
It's beautiful, {a}. Really.
Took four tries. Big fingers. Small scissors.
negative: You moved my chair again, {b}. The strong one.
It was in the middle of the room!
Middle's where I sit. Put it back.
Heard what you said. About orcs. At the pub.
It was a joke, {a}. Lighten up.
I laugh at good jokes. Didn't laugh.
You owe me twenty euros. Three weeks now.
I'll pay you Friday, I swear.
Said that last Friday. I remember Fridays.
Stop crossing the street when you see me. I see you do it.
I wasn't... I needed the other side.
Every day? Needed it every day?
You called the police on my cousin. He was singing.
At three in the morning! In goblin!
Fine. Fair. Still. Could've knocked.
OI! That's my lunch, {b}.
It was in the shared fridge.
Had my name on it. Big letters. Capitals.
You told the boss I broke the {door|shelf|press}.
Well, didn't you?
Yes. Wanted to tell him myself. Honest orcs confess.
Your dog bit me again.
He's just playing! He likes you.
He likes my ankle. Different thing.
You asked if I'm with the Horde. In front of everyone.
I was only curious, {a}.
Curious. Loud curious. Folk looked at me all day.
Borrowed my tools. Returned them bent.
They were bent already!
No. I bend things. I know my bends.
Stop calling me 'big guy', {b}.
It's affectionate!
Got a name. Use it. Short name. Easy.
Saw you cheat at darts.
Prove it.
Your foot was over the line. I'm tall. I see lines.
Your music. Too loud.
Rich, coming from you.
I'm loud in the day. You're loud at night. Different crime.
You stepped on my foot and didn't say sorry.
Your feet are everywhere, {a}!
Still my feet. Still want a sorry.
Told the landlord orcs break things. Now he won't fix my sink.
I never said that!
He said you did. Somebody's lying. Not me.
Hid from me at the market. Saw you behind the cabbages.
I wasn't hiding. I was choosing cabbages.
For ten minutes? Crouching?
Laughed at my tusk ring.
It's a bit much, isn't it?
It's mine. It stays. You can go.
You keep parking on my side. Moved your car twice now.
You moved my car? With your hands?
Third time it goes on the roof.
You said I wasn't welcome at the choir.
I said your voice was too low for the altos.
So put me with the basses. Problem solved. Sorry I shouted.
neutral: Loop bubble on the bridge. Driver won't risk it.
Where's the {post office|hardware shop|bakery} round here?
Thanks. Left's the one with the hand that doesn't write, yes?
Might take two. Sorry in advance.
Good. I'll wait. I'm good at waiting now.
Then I'll bring half an umbrella.
You know a good dentist? Big mouth. Big job.
There's one on Market Street. Very patient.
That shop sells big boots. You know it?
The one by the station? Yes, my brother buys there.
Not like you. Big feet, though.
Heard the news? Horde took another town up north.
Scary up there. Down here we've got buses. Keep calm.
Moved forty crates before lunch. Normal Tuesday.
Does this bus go past the {hospital|stadium|town hall}?
Good. I'll stand. Seats and me don't get on.
Thanks. He's usually scared of strangers.
Go early. I'm going too. I buy a lot.
What time's the library open till?
Good. Got a book to return. Late. Big fine.
Sweating like a forge. Sorry. Standing downwind.
Your roof's leaking. Saw it from the street.
I know. Can't afford a roofer yet.
Got a ladder? I'll look. No charge. Lunch, maybe.
Check it. People think orcs pinch.
It's all here. Thank you, really.
Yes, but it's sold out for tonight.
You watch the match last night?
Blind. Should've been an orc. We see everything.
Do they deliver here? Bought a bed. Special size.
They do, but it takes a week.
Waited twenty years for a bed that fits. One more week. Fine.
Price of bread's gone up again.
I eat a lot of bread. Feels personal.
Saw a mage on the corner. Fixing a streetlamp with a spell.
The Guild does that now. Saves on electricians.
Took him an hour. I'd have hit it. Ten seconds.
Last time I jumped in, they closed it for the day. Checking.
Lot of folk at the fair this year.
Strongman game's back. Going to have a go. Again.
She does that. She'll come down.
She's staring at me. Staring back. Long day.
This street got moved? Map says it's by the river.
Squishing moved it last spring. It's by the church now.
Ha. Streets move, I walk. Thanks.
Orcs wake early. And I like the smell.
Straight on, you can't miss it.
Can always miss it. I'll try not to.
Ah. Secret's out. Mine are small. Ish.
This your stall? How much for the {pears|honey|eggs}?
Is that what that is? I thought it was the boiler.
Another week of nest hair. Fine.
I did go over. Pavement lost.
Can you read this sign? Small letters.
Good. No car. Just checking I can stand here.
Same. Soak them. Salt water. Gran's trick.
Who's the statue in the square?
Bus is packed. Wait for the next one?
Good. I'd fill half of it anyway.

lines: Orcs should join the Horde. It's our blood.
Half your blood. The other half pays taxes here.
Taxes don't sing to me at night.
Neither does a spear in the ribs.
Doors should be taller. Everywhere.
Honestly? I've hit my head too.
See. Everyone suffers. Build up.
If someone insults you, you hit them. Simple.
Then you're the one in a cell.
Then you talk first. Then hit.
Or just talk.
...Fine. Sometimes.
The Mages' Guild talks big and does nothing.
Two factions arguing while the world squishes. Typical.
Put them in a room. Lock it. Lunch when they agree.
Liminal engine buses are a miracle. Fast, safe.
Safe? Near a loop bubble they fall apart.
So drivers keep away. Like a bad dog.
I'll take the slow tram, thanks.
Kids should learn a trade. Hands, not just books.
Both, I'd say. My nephew can't change a fuse.
Both. Yes. Books and fuses.
Junehem's good music. Say what you like.
It sounds like a blender full of nails.
Yes. Good blender.
They're leading an invasion, {a}!
Bad politics. Good drums. Both true.
Rent's robbery. Landlords should be fined.
Mine raised it twice this year.
Twice! Give me his address. To talk. Only talk.
The Vatican shouldn't be talking to the goblins.
Better talking than fighting, surely.
They don't want peace. They want an army.
Says who?
My mum. Mum hears things.
Speed limit's 80 and folk still try 81.
And then they're stuck in a loop for a month.
Serves them right. Walk. Walking's free.
Orcs make the best guards. Fact.
Dwarves are tougher.
Dwarves can't see over the counter.
They don't need to. They hear you coming.
Football's better than any war. Same shouting. Nobody dies.
Unless you're the referee.
Ha! Referee's fair game.
Magic's cheating. Do it with your hands.
Your hands can't heal a broken leg.
Splint. Bandage. Rest. Hands.
And a three month wait.
Bread should be cheap. Always. It's bread.
Couldn't agree more.
Good. Let's tell the baker. Together.
People should say what they mean. Straight.
Some things need a softer touch.
Soft touch is lying slowly.
Tell that to my mother-in-law.
Half-folk get it from both sides. Orcs, half-elves, all of us.
My dad was from abroad. I know what you mean.
Then you've got two halves too. Welcome to the club.
Eris's courts are a joke. Random sentences.
Better than no courts at all.
My cousin got six months for a hiccup.
Was it a very rude hiccup?
Best meal is the one after a hard day's work.
Hunger's the best sauce, my gran said.
Your gran and my gran. Same gran. Different tusks.
Goblins aren't monsters. They're family. Loud family.
They burned a town in Sweden last week.
Some did. Some bake bread in my street.
Hard to tell which is which.
Ask. Talk first. Always.
A promise is a promise. Break it, you're nothing.
My word's all I've got some days.
Then you're rich. Shake.

ambient: Bakery's got the good rolls today.
It walked right into the window!
Fixed that step outside the shop.
So that's why I didn't trip today!
Good soup at the corner place.
Stay on this side of the road.
Only if you're on our team.
Did you buy them all again?
Good to see you up and about.
